name: Common-Community-Hallucination-Benchmark
description: A community-contributed dataset designed to measure models' tendency to produce hallucinations on common/community-style prompts and tasks. It evaluates whether generated claims are supported by evidence or are fabricated, typically via human annotation or automated heuristics. The benchmark is intended for analyzing hallucination behavior rather than broad task performance.
reputation: Community-hosted dataset on Hugging Face used for preliminary hallucination analysis but with limited formal adoption in major benchmarks.
